Alex adds new secrets to the bottom of .env.local without touching existing lines, so check which duplicate key actually wins (Next uses the last) before claiming which key an environment runs on.
When several builder agents share one worktree on this 16 GB Mac, cap vitest at --maxWorkers=4, run one full suite at a time, and run tsc after vitest, never alongside.
